question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The students were ________ for their hard work with certificates and praise.
solution:
The correct answer is '**rewarded**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**rewarded**" means to give someone something in recognition of their efforts or achievements. (पुरस्कृत)
 
• In this context, the students were recognized for their hard work with certificates and praise, which aligns perfectly with the meaning of "rewarded."
 
• The other options: "**reprimanded**," "**penalised**," and "**punished**" convey negative connotations and are not suitable for the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The students were rewarded__ for their hard work with certificates and praise.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Reprimanded (डांटा गया)**: means to express sharp disapproval or criticism.
 
• **Penalised (दंडित)**: means to subject to a penalty for an offense or wrongdoing.
 
• **Punished (सज़ा दी गई)**: means to subject to a penalty as retribution for an offense.
